keyFindings.description: guardBrokenAskKeys covers only handleKeyDown. Typing a letter over a selection from the question into a two-item first list of a two-list ask runs ProseMirror's keypress insertText, which throws 'Content does not fit in gap' before preventDefault; in Chromium against the real server (2 of 2 runs) the browser's own edit removes the other, unselected option list from both pages and the stored document ('Which xion A\n\n- Option C'), and the ask is no longer marked malformed. Ctrl+X on the same selection throws the same (page error, nothing deleted). Needs handleTextInput and cut guards and browser rows.

On an ask holding a paragraph after its list, an options-only repair moves that paragraph into the question, and a question+options edit deletes it ('Stray words after the list' gone; Go probe against Postgres). Settlement keeps the row as it was before the break, so the caller never saw that text; the refusal's 'send options to rebuild the options as one list' leads to the deletion.

The content-rule decision is in four places; the post-write check (:122-128) never fails (quality probe: 30 shape x edit cases), and askBlockBodyChanges and askBlockChildren carry the same AskContentError exemption in two copies.
